definitions.gloss: seventh death anniversary; memorial service held in the sixth year after a death
definitions.explanation: A Buddhist memorial service marking the seventh observance of someone's death. In Japanese tradition, it is held six years after the death (counted inclusively, so the death year is year 1).

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{七回忌|ななかいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}む→営む：11837_itonamu⟧。
examples.english: To hold a seventh-year memorial service for my father.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{七回忌|ななかいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother's seventh-year memorial is next month.

examples.japanese: {七回忌|ななかいき}⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親族|しんぞく}→親族：14199_shinzoku⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Only close relatives gathered for the seventh-year memorial service.

notes:
Buddhist tradition counts memorial years inclusively: the death year is year 1, so the {七回忌|ななかいき} falls six calendar years later. After this point, attendance typically narrows to close family.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {七回忌|ななかいき}⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧: seventh-year memorial service
- {七回忌|ななかいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}む→営む：11837_itonamu⟧: to hold the seventh-year service
- {七回忌|ななかいき}⟦{法事|ほうじ}→法事：05634_houji⟧: seventh-year memorial event

MEMORIAL SERVICE SEQUENCE:
- ⟦{一周忌|いっしゅうき}→一周忌：06018_isshuuki⟧: 1 year after death
- ⟦{三回忌|さんかいき}→三回忌：06019_sankaiki⟧: 2 years after death
- {七回忌|ななかいき}: 6 years after death
- ⟦{十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}→十三回忌：28964_juusankaiki⟧: 12 years after death
- ⟦{三十三回忌|さんじゅうさんかいき}→三十三回忌：29130_sanjuusankaiki⟧: 32 years after death (often the final formal service)
